mapper.select:
SELECT s.security_id, s.ticker, s.name, s.type, s.kis_code IS NOT NULL AS kis_supported,
CASE WHEN s.rt_score IS NULL OR s.lh_score IS NULL OR s.rp_score IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND( 100.0 - ( (ABS(#{rtScore} - s.rt_score) + ABS(#{lhScore} - s.lh_score) + ABS(#{rpScore} - s.rp_score)) / 300.0 * 100.0 ), 1 ) END
NULL AS match_score, price_data.latest_volume AS volume, CASE WHEN price_data.prev_close IS NULL OR price_data.prev_close = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND( (price_data.latest_close - price_data.prev_close) / price_data.prev_close * 100, 2 ) END AS change_rate FROM securities s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT security_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN volume END) AS latest_volume, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN close_price END) AS latest_close, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN close_price END) AS prev_close FROM ( SELECT security_id, close_price, volume, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_id ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS rn FROM security_daily_prices WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM security_daily_prices) - INTERVAL 15 DAY ) ranked WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY security_id ) price_data ON price_data.security_id = s.security_id
s.type IN
#{type}
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.ticker LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY
(s.rt_score IS NULL OR s.lh_score IS NULL OR s.rp_score IS NULL) ASC, (ABS(#{rtScore} - s.rt_score) + ABS(#{lhScore} - s.lh_score) + ABS(#{rpScore} - s.rp_score)) ASC,
(price_data.latest_close IS NULL OR price_data.prev_close IS NULL OR price_data.prev_close = 0) ASC, ((price_data.latest_close - price_data.prev_close) / price_data.prev_close * 100) DESC,
(price_data.latest_volume IS NULL) ASC, price_data.latest_volume DESC,
s.name ASC,
s.security_id ASC,
s.security_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM securities
type IN
#{type}
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ticker LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT security_id, ticker, name, type, kis_code IS NOT NULL AS kis_supported, market, sector, market_cap, volatility, mdd AS max_drawdown, average_daily_move, average_volume FROM securities WHERE ticker = #{ticker}

SELECT ticker, kis_code FROM securities WHERE ticker IN
#{t}
